evidence_boundary: Primary sources support role, scope, representation, source dependence, and ambiguity architecture. The specific production senses in TrackSmith remain professional-practice hypotheses until source-aware evidence and listening support them.

records.identity: Marion Baranes, Romain Hennequin, and Elena V. Epure, Beyond Musical Descriptors: Extracting Preference-Bearing Intent in Music Queries
methods_and_evidence: 2291 Reddit queries
3935 annotations
descriptor spans assigned desired/positive, excluded/negative, or referential roles
two annotators
77.1 percent descriptor-span agreement
Cohen kappa 0.927 for roles on mutually extracted descriptors
Gemma 27B exact F1 0.69 and partial F1 0.76
limitations: retrieval queries rather than production-edit instructions
tracksmith_consequences: keep desired, prohibited, preserved, and referential roles distinct
resolve references to typed identities and attribute scope
use uncertainty or clarification when span/role is ambiguous
must_not_infer: the headline agreement proves robust negation
referential language is a positive global target

records.identity: Soumya Sai Vanka, Maryam Safi, Jean-Baptiste Rolland, and Gyorgy Fazekas, The Role of Communication and Reference Songs in the Mixing Process: Insights from Professional Mix Engineers
methods_and_evidence: five professional engineers in phase one
22 professional or pro-am engineers with more than three years experience in phase two
rough mixes, conversation, and references communicate different kinds of intent
approximately 90 percent of reference users reported more than one reference
reference scope may be whole mix, element, interaction, emotion, structure, or technical benchmark
limitations: about 95 percent male in phase two
no causal test of reference use or processing outcome
tracksmith_consequences: store reference identity, relation, target, and attribute scope
support iterative revision and contextual stopping
must_not_infer: a named record specifies a processor chain

records.identity: Thomas Wilmering, Gyorgy Fazekas, and Mark B. Sandler, Towards Ontological Representations of Digital Audio Effects
methods_and_evidence: multiple linked taxonomy views
separation of effect phenomenon, implementation, transform/application, parameter state, event, source track, and provenance
one concrete SPARQL provenance query demonstration
limitations: technical DSP ontology left for future work
tracksmith_consequences: keep semantic term, acoustic hypothesis, effect identity, implementation, parameter state, render, and source provenance separate
use typed IDs and lineage; RDF adoption is not required

records.identity: Satvik Venkatesh, David Moffat, and Eduardo Reck Miranda, Word Embeddings for Automatic Equalization in Audio Mixing
methods_and_evidence: 1595 total and 918 English examples
388 unique words
three audio files: electric guitar, piano, drums
40 EQ bands
frozen 300-dimensional GloVe, Tok2Vec, or Dict2Vec input
dense layers 300, 200, 100, 80, and 60
bounded minus 4 to plus 4 dB output
Tok2Vec MAE 0.760 versus no-embedding 0.836
Perceptual Centroid Metric human 2.9, GloVe 9.3, Tok2Vec 10.5, no-embedding 35.4
limitations: no listening test of generated EQ
source class is not a model input
tracksmith_consequences: use lexical or embedding similarity only for bounded candidate retrieval
condition hypotheses on explicit source and measurements
must_not_infer: semantic embedding selects the correct EQ
MAE or centroid distance proves perceptual success
a word means the same thing across source classes

records.identity: Joseph Cameron and Alan Blackwell, A Semantic Timbre Dataset for the Electric Guitar
methods_and_evidence: 275310 monophonic guitar notes
19 descriptors derived from 72 pedals and two software suites
VAE trained on 1771 E4 through D6 examples
Griffin-Lim reconstruction
20 listeners, 18 musically trained and eight guitarists
Tight MOS 2.91, Stutter MOS 2.74, Wah MOS 2.95
selected interpolation rankings Kendall tau 0.879
limitations: classifier trained within the constructed descriptor universe
tracksmith_consequences: treat magnitude/interpolation as candidates for audition
keep guitar evidence from silently transferring to other source classes
must_not_infer: classifier accuracy independently validates the labels
guitar Tight or Punch defines the same goal elsewhere

records.identity: Rebecca Salganik et al., MusicSem: A Semantically Rich Language--Audio Dataset of Natural Music Descriptions
methods_and_evidence: descriptive, contextual, situational, atmospheric, and metadata categories
32493 language-audio pairs
11842 songs
4430 artists
five English-language subreddits from 2008 through 2022
480 human-validated test entries
50 MusicCaps counterfactual sensitivity pairs written by trained musicians
generation sensitivity is average one minus cosine similarity
retrieval sensitivity is one minus top-k overlap ratio
reported CLaMP3 Recall at 10 is 26.84 percent on MusicSem
limitations: Reddit, genre, culture, language, and popularity bias
n-gram metrics do not imply semantic correctness
FAD depends on embedding and reference
CLAP score is insensitive to much contextual semantics
sensitivity measures response change rather than correctness
tracksmith_consequences: label atmospheric, situational, contextual, and metadata language separately from acoustic evidence
add counterfactual role and constraint tests
treat semantic similarity only as a retrieval signal
must_not_infer: CLAP or caption similarity proves the edit is correct
natural music descriptions have one acoustic realization
